up: Return exact activity values for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614521. Include the canonical SMILES, ChEMBL ID, and the exact activity value (standard_value), along with the standard_type and standard_units.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_units
FROM assays ass
JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614521'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
